Bathroom Remodeling in Colwich, KS

Colwich is northwest Sedgwick County's small rural community between Wichita and Goddard, near the Arkansas River. The homes are older and the character is genuinely rural — well and septic, larger lots, housing stock from the 1940s through 1970s that was built to last and has lasted, but hasn't been renovated to match how people live today.

Colwich bathroom remodels aren't about trends. They're about replacing bathrooms that have been in service for 50–70 years with something that works the way a bathroom is supposed to work — proper ventilation, a shower you can actually clean, fixtures that function, materials that last.

Wheatland Construction serves Colwich and northwest Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Colwich Bathroom Remodeling Considerations

Arkansas River corridor: Colwich's location in the Arkansas River drainage area creates seasonal moisture variability — clay-heavy alluvial soils and higher ambient humidity than locations to the north. Bathroom exhaust ventilation needs to actually pull moisture out of the space. We size fans for the room square footage and vent them to exterior.

Well-and-septic plumbing: Standard for Colwich's rural properties. We scope bathroom plumbing for well-water systems and assess septic capacity before adding fixtures.

Older construction — honest assessment: Pre-1970s Colwich homes may have galvanized supply lines, original cast-iron drain, and plaster walls. We open up, look at what's there, and price transparently before any work starts.

What We Build in Colwich Bathrooms

  • Tile shower or tub surround — membrane waterproofing, porcelain tile, quality fixtures
  • Vanity replacement with durable construction and quartz countertop
  • Plumbing updates — supply line replacement where assessed as needed
  • Exhaust fan — sized and vented properly to exterior

Permits in Colwich

City of Colwich for homes inside city limits; Sedgwick County for unincorporated properties. We determine jurisdiction and handle all permits.

How We Approach Bathroom Remodeling in

Every bathroom remodel in starts with an in-person assessment. Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in Colwich

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in Colwich, KS?

Colwich bathroom remodels range from $7,500 for a targeted refresh to $24,000+ for a full primary bath renovation. Rural northwest Sedgwick County pricing. Written, line-item estimates.

Does Colwich's Arkansas River location affect bathroom moisture?

It creates higher ambient humidity than drier locations. We size exhaust fans for the room and verify they're vented to exterior. For homes where ventilation has been inadequate, we check the subfloor and wall cavity condition before closing new tile.

Who handles permits for bathroom remodeling in Colwich?

City of Colwich for homes inside city limits. Sedgwick County for unincorporated properties. We determine which applies and handle all permits.

My Colwich home is on well and septic — does that matter for a bathroom remodel?

Yes for plumbing. We scope for well-water pressure systems and confirm septic capacity before adding fixtures.

What if I have original galvanized pipe in my Colwich home?

We assess condition. In older Colwich homes, 60–70-year-old galvanized is often running at reduced pressure and is a candidate for replacement during a remodel. We price both options and give you a straight recommendation.

How long does a Colwich bathroom remodel take?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Older homes with plumbing updates run toward the longer end.
